sample_unit: students who initiated treatment (17 completers analyzed for outcomes)
unlisted_practices: Using an LLM chatbot as an adjunct to group therapy for between-session support rather than as a stand-alone therapeutic agent
Excluding participants with psychiatric disorders, suicidal ideation, or psychotropic medication use from chatbot-supported care

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, acceptability, and safety of an LLM chatbot deployed to real university students as between-session adjunct support to group CBT, but does not compare or evaluate a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
